description: A small committed candidate-retrieval regression set. It validates metric plumbing and exact retrieval while preserving explicit sparse semantic-gap cases. It is not a substitute for the frozen unseen-paper benchmark.

corpus.text: LoRA freezes the pre-trained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices into each Transformer layer.
Segment Anything uses an image encoder, a prompt encoder, and a lightweight mask decoder for promptable segmentation.
RAG-Token can draw a different latent document for each generated token, while RAG-Sequence uses one document across the sequence.
FlashAttention is an IO-aware exact attention algorithm that reduces reads and writes between HBM and on-chip SRAM.
The diffusion forward process gradually adds Gaussian noise, and the learned reverse process removes noise to generate samples.
U-Net uses an overlap-tile strategy for seamless segmentation of arbitrarily large images.
NeRF represents a scene with a continuous function and renders views using differentiable volume rendering.
CLIP jointly trains an image encoder and text encoder by predicting which image and text pairings are correct.
DINOv2 builds a curated image dataset using retrieval from a large uncurated collection before self-supervised training.
Restormer introduces multi-Dconv head transposed attention and a gated-Dconv feed-forward network for image restoration.
Detector calibration estimates dark count and photon response before microscopy acquisition.
ADMM reconstruction alternates primal and dual optimization updates for inverse imaging.
